checks.detail: Real macOS package opened and showed New task, Knowledge, Skills & connections, and Hosts routes.
The Skills & connections page has a first-class Market tab with the Pi official extension catalog, Drone registry, and open-source MCP/Skill resource cards.
All eight @gyoungwe entries showed registry version and description before installation.
After scrolling the long official extension list, the Market/Connectors/MCP/Skills navigator remained visible in the real package.
Connector rows showed localized purpose descriptions and their real availability/toggle state.
Crossref was disabled and re-enabled in the real package; the row changed between 已禁用 and 可用.
Explicit Skill repository check completed against the packaged client and reported two available pack updates.
Installed desktop-ui-pack contribution was disabled and enabled again in the real package; Research status contribution remained observable after reload.
The isolated package had no configured MCP server, so the UI correctly showed no MCP capability instead of claiming an online result.
check-release-artifacts and check-local-desktop-artifact --strict passed for macOS arm64/x64.
Unsigned release policy; no certificate is available.
This acceptance remains macOS-only by the current release scope.
